items.title: AI-driven, large-scale nation-state campaign using ARTEX enables supply chain compromise
items.summary: Storm-0940 used ARTEX agentic AI to accelerate a ConnectWise supply chain compromise, enabling application credential abuse across Microsoft 365 environments.The post AI-driven, large-scale nation-state campaign using ARTEX enables supply chain compromise appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.
items.creator: Microsoft Security Research and Microsoft Threat Intelligence
